title: Full-Stack Developer
profile: Full-stack developer with 2.5+ years of production experience building REST APIs and database-backed systems in TypeScript and Node.js (NestJS), with React and Vue frontends. I design PostgreSQL schemas, enforce data integrity at the database level, and manage all my work through Git and GitHub, including CI with GitHub Actions. I write clean, maintainable code and ship end to end, from data model to API to UI.

education.institution: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology
education.degree: BSc Computer Science with MTN Bright Scholarship Reloaded. First Class Honours

bullets: Owned an automated financial computation engine end to end (data model, REST API, and a Kafka integration publishing finalized data to Amalitech's payroll system), enforcing data integrity via PostgreSQL triggers.
Worked in a team of 4 to build a logging system for aggregating and analyzing logs across services, using Spring Boot on the backend and React on the frontend.
Led a from-scratch EMR migration from TSOA to NestJS/Prisma with zero data loss, restructuring serialized JSON columns while keeping the API surface backward compatible for existing clients.

2.5+ years progressively owning backend systems for a health-tech platform, from intern to freelance engineer: cloud storage, verification flows, PDF generation, and real-time notifications (SSE, WebSocket).
Built stateful real-time flows on Node.js (NestJS) end to end, from data model through API to the client-facing notification.
Designed and delivered the full-stack website for CYALE, a youth-advocacy nonprofit in Abuesi, Ghana, using Nuxt, Vue 3, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, live at cyale.org.
Built member authentication, an impact showcase, event announcements, a donation flow, and a leadership directory, with Prisma for type-safe database access.

Built and run Orbit, a Jira-style project tracker in daily use by a small dev group: Nuxt 4 frontend, Nitro REST API on Vercel serverless functions, Postgres/Drizzle, with encrypted secrets (AES-256-GCM), audit logging, and TOTP MFA.
Published a GitHub Action that pulls a project's secrets from Orbit into CI, log-masked, instead of duplicating them into GitHub's secret store.
